note: Set A repeatedly misbinds members to the wrong detail (W8X10 and L3x3x1/4 attributed to West Roof Cantilever, HSS4X4X1/4 to East Roof Cantilever, 11"X3/8" plates to A4 Module Link where 5"X3/8" is shown) and adds vague or invented claims such as 'clearance/gap 1/4"', 'gap/offset 1/4"', 'slope 1/4"', and conditions like 'inner dimension' and 'from grade level to lower plate' that the drawing does not state. Set B captures verifiable sheet data (copyright, lot number, revision 2 date, T.O. STEEL 11'-4", FIRST FLR 2'-4", PL 4 1/2X4 1/2X1/2, 1/4" stiff plates, 3/8" plate thickness) with supporting quotes and only a few errors. B's main faults are treating the 1/4" weld/gap annotations as plate thickness or slope (the ▽ is a weld symbol, not slope) and one misbinding of L4X4X5/16 to West Roof Cantilever. Overall B is more faithful and less redundant.
